title: Receive what pleases the Divine before you interpret it.
summary: Not every hard arrival means abandonment. Start by remembering that what comes is not outside Divine pleasure or seeing.
lifeApplication: When the next interruption arrives, pause long enough to stop framing yourself as the sole author.

source.shortMeaning: What comes is still coming inside Divine authorship and permission.
source.lifeApplication: Begin with surrender instead of instant self-narration.

evidence.coreClaim: What comes is still coming inside Divine authorship and permission.
evidence.turn: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the next interruption arrives, pause long enough to stop framing yourself as the sole author.
